description: This file defines a verifier class and related functions for checking the correctness and consistency of exported Torch FX graphs and programs, including signature validation, node validation, and operator checks.

classes.name: SpecViolationError
classes.description: Custom exception class for specification violations.

classes.name: Verifier
classes.description: Base class for verifying Torch FX graphs and exported programs, with methods for allowed operations, graph checks, and signature validation.

classes.name: TrainingIRVerifier
classes.description: Subclass of Verifier for the 'TRAINING' dialect, with potential for additional checks.

methods.name: is_functional
methods.description: Checks if an OpOverload is functional (not mutable).

methods.name: _check_has_fake_tensor
methods.description: Placeholder for checking if a node has a fake tensor; currently calls _check_val.

methods.name: _check_val
methods.description: Validates the 'val' metadata of a FX node, ensuring it contains acceptable types.

methods.name: _check_torch_fn
methods.description: Validates the 'torch_fn' metadata of a FX node.

methods.name: getattr_recursive
methods.description: Recursively retrieves nested attributes from an object based on a dot-separated string.

methods.name: load_verifier
methods.description: Loads and returns a verifier class based on the specified dialect.
